_comment: Kessig Wolf Run 2026-10-22: the mana is better spent on a SPELL than on the pump, and the search does that.
Board: Courser of Kruphix (2/4, can attack), Kessig Wolf Run, one Mountain and two Forests; Lightning Bolt in
hand. Opponent at 5. The ONLY red source pays either the Bolt or the pump's {R}, never both. Pumping (X = 1,
the most the two Forests + Mountain pay beyond {R}{G}) swings for 3: opponent at 2, no kill. Bolt (3) + the
Courser's 2 is exactly 5: the T6 kill. The search must take the cast over the pump (the d0 greedy pump
would cost the turn). Library filler Swords to Plowshares (white -- never castable here).
